title: Election Regulations
summary: The governing rules for every association election: eligibility, the Election Commission, nomination, campaigning, polling and dispute resolution.

title: Election Code of Conduct
summary: What candidates, proposers, voters and officials may and may not do during an election period, and the penalties for breaching it.

title: Election Operations Manual
summary: The Election Commission’s working manual — the full timeline from announcement to declaration of results, step by step.

title: Polling & Counting Manual
summary: How a manual ballot is run on polling day: booth setup, ballot issue, sealing, counting, recounts and the result sheet.

title: Forms Handbook — Part I (ER-01 to ER-24)
summary: Announcement, Commission appointment, voter roll, nomination and polling-day forms. Each one opens as a ready-to-use sheet on the Association letterhead and prints on A4.

title: Form ER-25 — Ballot Box Sealing & Poll Integrity Certificate
summary: Signed at the close of poll to certify that the ballot box was sealed in the presence of the agents present.

title: Forms Handbook — Part II (ER-22A, ER-25A to ER-35A)
summary: Counting authorisation, tally, recount, result certification, complaints, appeals, handover and closure forms, plus the signature matrix and retention schedule.

title: Forms Appendices — Signatures, Custody & Retention
summary: Which officers must sign which form, the chain of custody for election material, and how long each record is kept.
